alignments.note: לָכֵן is one English word Therefore, so the two morphemes share a unit (rule 30); headed on s001, which MACULA lemmatizes as the whole compound. Heading on כֵּן is the competing reading.

כַּאֲשֶׁר rendered by the single word As, so the preposition and the relative share a unit (rule 30), headed on the comparative preposition that carries the lexeme.
Construct rendered attributively as the vine tree, so no of is written (rule 28).
The single written the stands at the phrase's left edge and is taken by the present article morpheme (rules 29, 47).

review_notes: Two multi-morpheme fusions are taken here, לָכֵן → Therefore and כַּאֲשֶׁר → As, both satisfying rule 30's one-English-word condition; each unit's note records the competing head.
עֵץ־הַגֶּפֶן is rendered attributively (rule 28) while עֵץ הַיַּעַר takes of with two written the's (rule 29's arthrous clause), which is why the two chains are aligned differently.
